fam12_analysis.finding: FAM-12 absorbed 662 broad search-demand query terms that represent general agency capability discovery without specifying a single service stream.

fam05_analysis.finding: Service-specific pricing queries (e.g. 'SEO retainer price') were categorized under their respective service streams (FAM-01) in Candidate Mode to enable context-rich responses.

decisionMatrix.evidence: 662 records assigned in candidate mode (649 marked ambiguous due to generic search terms)
decisionMatrix.problem: FAM-12 contains a large volume of generic search terms ('IT consulting', 'business automation') that do not specify a single service stream.
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Retain as General Capability Inquiry (FLOW-02) and route to service discovery. Option B: Split FAM-12 into 4 service-stream discovery sub-families.
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Retain as FLOW-02 Value Proposition & Service Discovery

decisionMatrix.evidence: 7 explicit generic pricing records in FAM-05 + 1 service-specific pricing records absorbed into FAM-01/FAM-02
decisionMatrix.problem: Should service-specific pricing queries (e.g. 'SEO retainer cost') be classified under their service family (FAM-01) or under dedicated Pricing (FAM-05)?
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Service-specific pricing stays with service family (FLOW-06) for context-rich answers; generic pricing queries ('fee kitni hai') map to FAM-05. Option B: Move all pricing queries into FAM-05.
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Retain service-context pricing under respective service streams

decisionMatrix.candidate_family: FAM-01: SEO vs Website Redesign Overlap
decisionMatrix.evidence: 58 records in FAM-01 contain both 'SEO' and 'Website' wording (e.g. 'SEO chahiye website ke liye')
decisionMatrix.problem: When a query contains both 'SEO' and 'website', which capability intent takes precedence?
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Enforce Tier-0 rule precedence where explicit capability intent ('SEO') takes priority over generic container wording ('website'). Option B: Treat as multi-intent clarification (FLOW-01).
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Enforce explicit capability precedence (SEO > generic website)

decisionMatrix.candidate_family: FAM-06: Audit Intake vs Informational Audit FAQ
decisionMatrix.evidence: 20 records in FAM-06 (19 real customer briefs + 1 synthetic FAQ)
decisionMatrix.problem: Distinguish between actionable audit intake requests ('audit karwana hai') and informational queries ('audit kya hota hai?').
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Actionable audit requests route to FLOW-04 Intake; informational queries route to FLOW-02 Value Prop. Option B: Route all audit mentions to FLOW-04.
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Separate actionable audit intake (FLOW-04) from informational audit FAQs (FLOW-02)

decisionMatrix.candidate_family: FAM-08: Consultation Scheduling vs Human Handoff
decisionMatrix.evidence: 5 real customer contact briefs requesting leadership consultation
decisionMatrix.problem: Distinguish between 30-minute discovery booking ('book call') and real-time human chat handoff ('talk to human').
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Discovery meeting requests route to FLOW-05 booking link; live human handoff triggers direct contact info + asynchronous lead capture. Option B: Merge both into FLOW-05.
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Separate discovery booking (FLOW-05) from live human handoff

decisionMatrix.candidate_family: FAM-09: Pricing Request vs Budget Objection
decisionMatrix.evidence: Queries comparing agency rates vs freelancers or requesting cheaper options ('sasta', 'freelancer')
decisionMatrix.problem: Ensure budget objections ('freelancer se karwa lunga') do not trigger standard pricing templates.
decisionMatrix.options: Option A (Recommended): Route budget/freelancer objections to FLOW-07 (engineering value qualification); route standard price asks to FLOW-06. Option B: Treat all as pricing requests.
decisionMatrix.recommended_option: Option A: Retain dedicated FLOW-07 objection qualification for freelancer/cheap rate queries
